intent.why: The request is for one image generated from text, with no attachments. The subject, square aspect, lighting, style, and absence of text are all specified.

turns.say: I’ll make a square, text-free product shot of a matte black insulated water bottle on pale concrete, with soft studio lighting and a premium minimalist look for your Instagram feed.

image.prompt: Use generate_image to create a premium minimalist studio product photograph, square 1:1, featuring one matte black insulated water bottle standing upright on a pale concrete surface. The bottle is large in frame, centered horizontally, occupying approximately 75% of the image height, with generous clean space around it and its base visible in the lower fifth. Give it a simple cylindrical silhouette, gently rounded shoulders, a narrow neck, and a matching screw-top cap with a subtle seam; no handle, graphics, logos, or text. Keep the bottle identity, upright pose, unadorned finish, concrete setting, soft lighting, and square framing fixed; no source image is supplied. Position the camera near the bottle’s mid-height, almost straight on with a slight downward angle revealing a sliver of the cap’s top. Illuminate from upper left with a large diffused neutral-white studio softbox, producing a broad restrained highlight along the left edge, soft fill on the right, and a delicate shadow extending rightward. Render the powder-coated surface with fine tactile texture and controlled reflections. Use a charcoal-black, pale warm-gray, and off-white palette, with subtle concrete pores and a seamless softly graduated background. Maintain crisp product edges and realistic materials; review the finished still before using it as any video reference.
